L10·N2068unmasked layer
Fires on tokens sitting *inside* an unfinished multi-word noun phrase — the second/third element of a name or compound modifier (e.g. "Brown **Taylor**", "mortgage **closing** industry", "low cost **residential** conveyancing", "Dr**.** Seuss", the comma in "colors**,** and diversity") — i.e. positions where more of the phrase must follow; it is strongly suppressed at sentence/paragraph boundaries (the newline after a final period, a sentence-initial "There", trailing "??").

L10·N8547unmasked layer
Fires (weakly, at its positive extreme) on the highly predictable function-word completion of a fixed collocation or idiom — e.g. the "to" of "in a bid to"/"click…to enlarge"/"sign in to let us know", the "more" of "reported more frequently", the "a" of "twice a year"; it is strongly suppressed on head nouns that categorize a preceding modifier ("turbo version", "classification category").
